2023–24: 2,208 LEAs were surveyed; 1,579 responses were recorded (about 72%). The report also states an 87% response rate among the remaining 1,823 LEAs after excluding 385 that did not offer TK. It records 244 nonresponses or missed deadlines.

2024–25: 1,464 LEAs were surveyed; 952 responses were recorded (about 65%). Of these, 26 indicated they did not offer TK; 926 were reported as having at least one TK program (stated as 95%, which describes program availability rather than the overall survey response rate). It records 512 nonresponses or missed deadlines.

Thus, both the number surveyed and responses recorded decreased, and the stated overall response rate fell from about 72% to about 65%.
